layerFertilityNote: What vanilla's block layers see (0..255) for each tier: low topsoil from 64 (0.25), its low subsoil from 77 (0.30); medium topsoil from 128 (0.5), medium subsoil from 153 (0.6). Barren is laid as low over low subsoil; medium, high and black earth as medium over medium subsoil. Then barren, high and black earth have their top block and the block under it swapped (soil-verylow, soil-compost, soil-high), so a forest floor laid later lies on soil of the column's grade.
floodRainNote: Vanilla's layers lay no soil where their rain is below 0.08 (or grass below 0.12): a column of an arid river's flood gets this rain in the block layers only (not the climate map), so its soil lies across the flood, sparsely grassed.
tundraWarmestBelowNote: Polar and alpine ground beyond the tree line (warmest month below about 10 C at the column's height): barren in both tier sets, whatever the class (SoilGrids calls much of it Cambisols or Leptosols).
